# AdaptiveAsymmetricSurrogateGradients

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A training method using adaptive and asymmetric surrogate gradients to improve the learning efficiency of spiking neural networks. Enables more effective training of neuromorphic hardware, addressing the non-differentiability of spike events and improving convergence in iNEST implementations.
